claims.summary: Structured owners hold mutable lane state, writer scope, and schema; narrative owners route stable semantics only.
Mutable per-lane readiness and product/public-state fields are keyed by lane_id in the structured status index.
Repo-local hooks provide deterministic reminders and bounded guards.
Hooks are guardrails, not semantic or product-authority judges.
Readiness vocabulary and promotion exit semantics are stable validation policy, not mutable lane state.
Promotion requires capability, public surface, authority, behavior delta, validation, replay, and rollback evidence.
Productization work limits WIP and requires intake, maintenance, closeout, and explicit stop/exit rules.
The broad Backfill candidate/audit universe is not a writer pool and remains parked.
Diagnostics, evidence providers, reviews, and labels do not grant ProductWriter authority without activation and expected-diff contracts.
The dated queue and maintenance chronology are historical provenance only and must not remain current authority.
